title: People planning quick-capture — interview loop triage & 1:1 agenda
body:
Purpose: quick capture for Friday 1:1 with Lina (eng manager) + follow-ups for weekly HC sync. Not polished — raw checklist and immediate asks.

Top-level objectives for meeting (5–10m):
- Confirm hiring prioritization for Eng Platform vs Serving Runtime for Q2. Lina to confirm 2 ICs vs 1 IC plus contract engineer.
- Decide interview-loop fixes for backend IC role (reduce round trip time, add standardized rubric).
- Flag any blockers (budget commit, equipment lead time, onboarding capacity).

Candidate pipeline snapshot (as of 2026-03-11):
- Backend IC: 6 in pipeline (2 onsites scheduled w/ feedback pending), 1 offer extended but pending comp approval.
- Infra SWE: 3 in screen stage (contractor backup identified).
- SRE (mid): 2 under review by hiring manager.
- TPM (staff): paused pending headcount approval.

Observed pain points / notes to surface:
- Loop length: Backend role doing 5-stage loop (screen -> tech screen -> take-home -> onsite -> hire committee). Ask: reduce take-home or parallelize tech screen + take-home to cut cycle time by 7–10 days.
- Inconsistent rubrics: interviewers giving divergent pass/fail signals. Propose short rubric template (problem solving, system design, communication, ownership examples).
- Debrief lag: interviewers often late submitting notes (avg 3.6 days). Propose 48-hour expectation + automated reminder Slack workflow.
- Offer approvals: comp review queue causing hold-ups. Suggest building a pre-approval deck for hires < L5 to speed 24–48h.

Decision items for Lina (explicit asks):
1) Approve experiment to drop take-home for Backend IC and replace with a 60-min paired coding session for onsite (owner: Lina) — decision by 2026-03-18.
2) Greenlight hiring of 1 dedicated onboarding buddy for next 2 months (owner: People Ops / Lina to confirm capacity) — need headcount code or budget holder.
3) Approve temporary offer decoupling for one contractor to start earlier if comp approval lags (owner: Finance + Lina) — escalate to Marcus if needed.

Proposed quick rubrics (talking points):
- Scoring: 1–4 per dimension; highlight must-have vs nice-to-have items.
- Dimensions: Technical correctness, System design at required level, Ownership & product sense, Collaboration (culture fit), Communication clarity.
- Use single-line examples for each score band to speed debriefs.

Immediate follow-ups (my tasks after 1:1):
- Draft rubric template and circulate to Lina + Kenji by EOD 2026-03-11 (owner: Eden).
- Create a Jira ticket to update candidate pipeline board automation for reminders (owner: Eden, link to ticket in linked_artifacts once created).
- Draft short pre-approval slide for L4–L5 hires and ask Finance for a standing approval for up to 2 hires per quarter (owner: Eden, due 2026-03-18).
- Add paired coding session script & rubric to GH repo (owner: Kenji, ask in 1:1).

Questions I want Lina to answer in 1:1 (note to self):
- Can we temporarily reallocate one headcount from Console team (low-priority feature) to Platform for 8 weeks? Which line item would that map to?
- Is there appetite to have interviewing trainers run a 30-min calibration session for interviewers next Thursday?
- Who is the budget owner for contractor conversion approvals?

Risks & contingencies to raise:
- If comp approvals continue to take >72h, pipeline will lose top candidates. Contingency: escalate to Marcus + offer approved signatory for fast hires.
- Onboarding capacity: if no buddy assigned, new hires' 30-day ramp suffers, target ramp metric drop by ~20%. Contingency: engage Solutions Eng to provide temporary office hours.

Notes for meeting cadence / phrasing (copyable):
- "My ask: two small experiments to shorten loop time — swap take-home for paired coding and a 48-hour debrief expectation. We'll measure impact on cycle time and candidate satisfaction."
- "If we get one onboarding buddy and pre-approval deck, we can reduce time-to-start by ~14 days for top candidates."

Longer-term proposals to table after 1:1:
- Centralized interview feedback dashboard (product) that aggregates rubrics + candidate net sentiment.
- Quarterly 'calibration' sessions with rotating interviewers + anonymized transcripts.
- A small conversion fund to cover sign-on bonuses for critical hires (pilot, 3 hires).

Misc scratch notes / brainstorming fragments:
- Could we use Redwood Console event traces to measure how many days between onsite and offer note submission automatically? (Pinging observability team)
- Potential to A/B test paired vs take-home on small cohort (n=20) — metric: accept rate + cycle time + hiring manager satisfaction.
- Slack snippet to propose in hiring channel: short rubric + 48-hour note policy.

End-of-doc quick checklist (post-1:1):
- [ ] Send rubric draft to Lina + Kenji
- [ ] Open Jira reminder ticket
- [ ] Draft pre-approval slide for Finance
- [ ] Confirm onboarding buddy or fallback plan
- [ ] Schedule 30-min calibration session if Lina agrees

Unresolved: which Console line item to borrow (ask Lina).

Timestamped capture: edited quick at 2026-03-11 09:20 — will iterate after 1:1 (Friday 2026-03-12).
